title: Dehomag, IBM's German subsidiary, ahead in transistors

tellings.quote: German subsidiary of IBM, a company called Dehomog >> was way ahead

plain: Dehomag, the German subsidiary of IBM in the Nazi era, was "way ahead" in electronics, Michels says, and the story has it ahead in transistors. He says it himself, without a source, in a conversation with the philosopher Jason Jorjani about a claimed secret Nazi UFO programme, where it would mean Germany had technology far beyond what is usually credited.
